name: Climbing the Corporate Ladder at Wendys
source:
Your time at Wendy's has hit a boiling point. Incompetent coworkers, a manager sent straight from the depths of a fry trap, and a rage you just can't seem to quench. When a management position finally opens, your chance to take over is finally here; but in a corporation like this, if you're going to make things right, you're gonna need to do a lot of wrong!

Sabotage, slander, and slay your way to the top! Don't let anyone get in your way! Become manager even if it means taking out the competition in Climbing The Corporate Ladder At Wendy's.

[From [url=https://jeebsmakesgames.itch.io/ctcla-wendys]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在温迪的时光已经达到了沸点。无能的同事，直接从鱼苗陷阱深处派来的经理，以及你似乎无法平息的愤怒。当管理职位终于空缺时，你接手的机会终于来了；但在这样的公司里，如果你想把事情做好，你就需要做很多错事！

破坏、诽谤，一路杀到巅峰！不要让任何人妨碍你！成为经理，即使这意味着在“温迪的企业阶梯攀登”中击败竞争对手。

[来自[url=https://jeebsmakesgames.itch.io/ctcla-wendys]itch.io[/url]]
